subject: general
question: Which of the following Indian states was NOT the host of FIFA Under-17 Women's World Cup Football 2022?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Punjab.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Punjab** was not chosen as a host state for the FIFA Under-17 Women's World Cup Football 2022.
 
• **Maharashtra, Goa, and Odisha** were chosen as the host states for the tournament.
 
• The FIFA Under-17 Women's World Cup Football 2022 was originally scheduled to be held in India from 17 February to 7 Marc
